N-4.1-A.skill: interpret a derivative value with units, separating marginal rate, average rate and percent change.

N-4.1-B.skill: estimate a derivative from a table with uneven spacing and state its units when the function is itself a rate.

N-4.2-A.skill: decide direction and speeding up or slowing down from the signs of v and a.

N-4.2-B.skill: find total distance traveled from a position function by locating the times the particle reverses direction.

N-4.3-A.skill: read increasing or decreasing and concavity from a table of a rate of change, and describe it as speeding up or slowing down.

N-4.3-B.skill: compare marginal cost with average cost to decide whether average cost is rising or falling.

N-4.4-A.skill: build a relationship from similar triangles and differentiate it with respect to time.

N-4.4-B.skill: reduce a two-variable volume formula to one variable using a stated constraint, then differentiate with respect to time.

N-4.5-A.skill: use a constraint to write V in one variable, differentiate, and evaluate at an instant without substituting the value early.

N-4.5-B.skill: relate the distance between two moving objects to their rates, using signs for approaching and receding motion.

N-4.6-A.skill: form a tangent-line estimate and decide over or under from the trend of f′ in a table.

N-4.6-B.skill: use a linear approximation to turn a percent error in a measurement into a percent error in a derived quantity.

N-4.7-A.skill: recognize that L'Hospital's Rule must be applied more than once, rechecking the form after each step.

N-4.7-B.skill: recognize when L'Hospital's Rule is inconclusive because the limit of the derivative quotient does not exist.
